thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Billing alert: surge in overage flags detected (12x baseline) and token-count delta +48% over expected for the last 10m. Affected pipelines: token-emitter -> billing-aggregator. Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboard/alerts/1796543210  Pager routed to @oncall-anna

oncall-anna: acked. Looking at metrics now. Any recent deploys to billing?

sre-matt: no deploys in billing in last 6h. Seeing consumer lag on kafka-topic `usage-events` — consumer group `billing-emitter` lag ~ 18m and spike of duplicate acks. Also some 500s from aggregator when windowing spikes.

billing-lina: customer-facing flags already triggered (automated overage emails). Can we pause them?

support-kate: customers starting to DM support, low volume but high urgency. Recommend pause automated emails and mark impacted customers as "investigating".

oncall-anna: pausing notifications now (runbooks -> billing -> pause-overage-notifs).

incidents-bot: action taken: automated overage-notifs disabled by oncall-anna (link to runbook).

eng-ops-jason: I'm looking at emitter logs. There's a burst of replays from upstream (retry storm) — timestamps show backlog created around 2026-03-18T02:12:xxZ. Suggest restart of `billing-emitter` consumer to clear stuck offsets + enable rate limit gate.

sre-matt: agreed. Preparing restart. Command: ```kubectl -n billing rollout restart deployment/billing-emitter```

eng-ops-jason: running restart now. will monitor offsets.

eng-ops-jason: restart issued. Offset lag dropping from 18m -> 4m within 3m. Backlog drain rate improving.

billing-lina: can we trigger shadow re-count to validate totals before unpausing emails? We should avoid false rebilling.

sre-matt: we can run a shadow reconciliation job against aggregated raw events (non-billed) — ETA ~25m to produce diff. Kicking it off: `jobs/reconcile --topic usage-events --mode shadow --window 10m`

billing-lina: thanks. Also recommend a temporary invoice freeze for accounts with flagged overages > $500 until we confirm. Legal ok?

legal-tom: temporary freeze OK for now, document rationale, include start/end times and owner. Keep comms conservative.

support-kate: drafting customer note: "We've detected an internal metering anomaly affecting a subset of usage reports. We are investigating and will not bill for suspected duplicate usage. We'll follow up within 24 hours with next steps." Ping me for review.

incidents-bot: post-deploy health checks show aggregator error rate trending down to baseline, token-delta reducing to +6%.

sre-matt: shadow reconciliation started. Early sample diffs show duplicate replays causing ~40% overcount for impacted window.

eng-ops-jason: mitigation checklist: 1) restart billing-emitter (done), 2) re-enable consumer rate-limits upstream (in progress), 3) run shadow-reconcile (started), 4) pause automated billing notifications (done), 5) invoice freeze for large flags (approved).

oncall-anna: handing off to billing-lina for follow-ups and post-incident lead. I'm going offline in 25m but reachable for escalations.

billing-lina: taking incident lead. Will coordinate support comms and confirm reconciliation output. Creating ticket JIRA-INC-4421 for root-cause & remediation.

support-kate: customer note ready, sending to affected subset now with template and support routing.

incidents-bot: shadow-reconcile finished (report link: https://redwood/reports/reconcile/1796543210). Summary: confirmed ~38% duplicate token emissions for window 02:10-02:25Z, estimated flagged invoices affected: 74 accounts, estimated false charge exposure ~$2.6k.

billing-lina: unpause billing-notifs only after we verify re-run totals and clear automated flags. I'll run final re-count and patch aggregator dedupe rules.

sre-matt: final re-count running. ETA 10m. Also adding consumer health alert to prevent future silent lag >5m.

eng-ops-jason: added temporary circuit-breaker in upstream retry logic to prevent replay storms. Will make permanent in next sprint.

incidents-bot: final metric check: token-delta back to +1.5%, aggregator errors at baseline.

billing-lina: final re-count completed, diffs reconciled, false overages cleared. Re-enabled billing notifications for normal ops. Invoice freeze removal approved.

support-kate: outbound customer follow-up sent with explanation and confirmation that no duplicate charges will be applied.

oncall-anna: thanks team, good mitigation. Please include these notes in the postmortem.

billing-lina: postmortem kickoff created: JIRA-INC-4421. Action items: (A) root cause: upstream retry/replay storm + missing dedupe window, (B) short-term: consumer alerting, retry circuit-breaker, invoice freeze runbook, (C) long-term: stronger end-to-end checks and an automated shadow-reconcile weekly job. Owners assigned.

legal-tom: preserve communications and audit trail for any customer billing disputes.

incidents-bot: incident status -> resolved (duration ~36m). Follow-up: postmortem due in 3 business days.

oncall-anna: resolved. Good work everyone :thumbsup:

support-kate: closing thread, moving notes to incident doc and support case queues.

billing-lina: will run final ledger scrub overnight and confirm tomorrow AM.

incidents-bot: thread closed at 1796543278."
